title: [Bug] Shift+Tab Triggers Unintended IDE Accessibility Shortcuts
body:
**Bug Description**
shift+tab started invoking cursor IDE accessibility shortcut and cycling through the IDE controls in addition to changing the claude code modes

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: cursor
- Version: 1.0.119
- Feedback ID: f9fbaff4-f919-4c43-b7f3-1bf22a2f59b6

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error: 1: 1 \n    at fQ9 (/$bunfs/root/claude:1741:4099)\n    at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2025-09-19T06:09:32.671Z"}]
```
author: Maxymvs
